_readme: Parts map for tools/gen_jlc_bom_cpl.py. Keyed by the board's Value string.
PACKAGE MUST MATCH THE PLACED FOOTPRINT. 74HC595 alone has 18 LCSC variants across
SOP-16 / SOIC-16 / TSSOP-16; a TSSOP part will not fit the SOIC-16 lands on this board.
PREFER JLC 'basic' PARTS EVEN WHEN DEARER. At qty 1 the per-unique-extended-part fee is
a fixed cost and this BOM has 49 lines, so those fees dominate. 74HC595: the basic SOIC-16
is $0.171 against $0.044 for the cheapest extended SOP-16 - 39 cents more across 3 chips,
against a per-part fee many times that.
STATUS: PARTIAL. Lines with lcsc null still need sourcing.

74HC595.comment: 74HC595D,118 Nexperia, SOIC-16 - JLC BASIC. Package matches the placed SOIC-16_3.9x9.9mm land

TPL7407L.comment: TPL7407LAPWR TSSOP-16, 7ch low-side driver. 1M internal input pulldowns = no relay clack at boot

STM32F446RET6.comment: LQFP-64 10x10. CAN1 on PB8/PB9, USB OTG FS on PA11/PA12

BTS7040-1EPA.comment: PROFET+2 high-side switch, TSDSO-14 - the ignition latch

BMI270.comment: Bosch 6-axis IMU, LGA-14. KiCad BMI160 symbol is pin-identical (verified)

LD1117S33.comment: SUBSTITUTED: AMS1117-3.3 SOT-223, JLC BASIC. Same SOT-223 pinout (GND/OUT/IN) as the LD1117S33 in the schematic; 1.7V headroom from 5V is ample

47R.comment: 0805 - PROFET RGND network, REQUIRED for reverse-battery ReverseON

10k.comment: 0805 - button pull-ups (wetting current), OE_N pull-up, BOOT0 pulldown

270k.comment: 0805 - sense divider lower leg. 1M/270k clears 74HC VIH at 12.0V; 220k did NOT

10uF_50V.comment: 1210 50V - input bulk on the battery rail

8MHz.comment: SMD5032 2-pin, 20pF load - HSE. Matches joesbox's stock RCC_HSE_ON PLLM=8

PPTC_1A.comment: 1812 resettable fuse, 1A hold. Must be rated for the battery rail

PWR_IN.comment: KF2EDGVM-3.5-2P header. Screw plug KF2EDGK-3.5-2P C440847 bought separately

WAVESHARE-IN.comment: 4x 2.54mm male pins at 3.50mm pitch - buck module socket, hand-fit

WAVESHARE-OUT.comment: 6x 2.54mm male pins - buck module socket, hand-fit
